info.name: WulfCasino — Agent API
info.description:
Agent/affiliate-portal REST API. **Agents are employee accounts** — they log in through `POST admin/auth/login` (see the Authentication folder here) and every agent endpoint is protected by the employee `JwtAuthGuard`. The collection sends Bearer `{{agentToken}}`.

Covers affiliate stats, sub-agent management, commissions, agent deposits/withdrawals via Breeze & Coinflow, packages, promo codes, and agent notifications.

---
### Variables
| Variable | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `{{baseUrl}}` | API base URL **including** the `/api/v1` prefix (default `http://localhost:8000/api/v1`) |
| `{{playerToken}}` | Player JWT — auto-saved by the login requests in the Player collection |
| `{{agentToken}}` | Agent JWT — agents log in through the same `/auth` endpoints |
| `{{adminToken}}` | Admin/employee JWT — auto-saved by the admin login request |

Import `WulfCasino-Local.postman_environment.json` and select the **WulfCasino Local** environment before sending requests.

*Generated from the NestJS source (controllers, DTOs, and guards) — request bodies are realistic examples built from the validation DTOs; optional query params are included but disabled.*

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Agents are employee accounts: they log in through the **admin** auth endpoints (`admin/auth/*`), not the player `/auth` flow. This login stores the JWT in `{{agentToken}}`.

request.description:
Logs an agent in with their employee credentials. The response JWT is auto-saved to `{{agentToken}}` by the test script, authorizing every other request in this collection.

**Auth:** none (public endpoint).

request.description:
Sub-agent creates a hosted Breeze payout page for their existing agent-payment request. releaseMethod enum: MANUAL | AUTOMATIC. preferredPayoutMethods items enum: BANK_ACCOUNT | CARD | CRYPTO_WALLET.

**Auth:** Bearer JWT (admin/employee token from admin login).

Direct agent opens a hosted Breeze page WITHOUT first creating a payout request; the request is materialized when Breeze confirms a payout method. releaseMethod enum: MANUAL | AUTOMATIC. preferredPayoutMethods items enum: BANK_ACCOUNT | CARD | CRYPTO_WALLET.

**Auth:** Bearer JWT (admin/employee token from admin login).
